about_the_game:
An RPG where something is off...

Make an original character in a surprisingly in depth pixel character creator, and then choose one of three worlds to set out. Your choices are your own, but the game has it's own devious plans for you.

TeleCollision has turn based combat, with each character having a unique timing based action to master for increased damage. Your party is made up of a collection of colorful characters that find themselves deeply tied a story you've fallen into upon setting out on your journey. Each one has their own strengths and mechanical use against enemies that can't always be attacked head on!

In traditional RPG fashion, your player character can change equipment to adjust their stats, but also has access to a menagerie of trading cards to equip to change their stats, abilities, and passive effects! There's an entire catalogue of trading cards to collect through exploration, purchasing, and opening trading card packs for a random chance at rare and powerful cards!

TeleCollision's demo includes roughly 8 hours of content, and what is considered the first act of the game. Community feedback is welcome and appreciated at this stage of development as the combat is tweaked and polished.

name: TeleCollision
short_description: TeleCollision is a pixelated RPG where fiction collides! After making your original character, you set out on a story of your choice. But something is off... And that gray man in the bowler keeps showing up...
